title: The Secret of the Whispering Underwater Cave
synopsis: The seashell wraps Lumi, Bobo, Draco and Kiko in a bubble; Nimbus waves goodbye and they drop into the sea. Bobo chases a fish that looks exactly like a banana ('Even the fish are teasing me about bananas!') and Draco's 'fastest swimmer' boast rolls the whole bubble over. Coralie welcomes them at a cave that whispers 'Help us...'; Bobo hides behind Draco, whose wings shake ('a powerful dragon technique!'). Inside, shy baby octopus Bloop hiccups a giant bubble that floats Bobo upside down, and Kiko bounces off it. The Whisper Crystal has lost three pieces: a hiccup bubble lifts Lumi to the first, Kiko proudly finds a glowing jellyfish ('That's definitely not a crystal!') before the real second piece, and Draco's fireball is one tiny steam bubble. At a rock in a strong current, Lumi helps Bloop make calm, controlled bubbles; Bobo is carried off and lands on Draco ('underwater transportation!'). The pieces restore the crystal, the cave lights up and sings, and Kiko steals Bobo's golden sea-banana.
ending: The Whisper Crystal projects an ancient clock tower standing in a magical forest. 'An ancient clock tower? I wonder what secrets it holds!' Next: The Secret of the Ancient Clock Tower.
newCharacters: Bloop, a tiny shy turquoise baby octopus with magical hiccups that make bubbles: eight short soft tentacles, big purple eyes, pink cheeks, a smiling face and tiny glowing spots on its head (Bloop in src/ep11/props.tsx, voice af_jessica pitched 1.38)
